rows.name: new-deck
rows.expected: open /new; the editor is ready on the cover; a blank slide with a 20 px text box added through the window API; back on the cover
rows.observed: deck untitled-20260930-e85m; cover title; blank slide blank-1 with fx-agenda at 20 px

rows.name: title-select
rows.expected: one click on the title placeholder: the heading is selected with its ring and chip, no session; Paint format on the toolbar reads enabled and not pressed
rows.observed: selected true; resize handles 8; rotate true; ring true; chip "Title"; session false; caret false; Paint format aria-disabled null, aria-pressed null, is-on false; 03-before-03-title-selected.png

rows.name: paint-arm
rows.expected: Paint format clicked with the title placeholder selected: the brush arms (the stage carries data-paint), the button reads aria-pressed true with the pressed ground, no snackbar
rows.observed: stage data-paint true; button aria-pressed null, is-on false; snackbar none; 05-before-05-paint-armed.png

rows.name: paint-apply
rows.expected: the blank slide's card clicked with the brush armed, then the 20 px text box: the box takes the cover heading's size and weight in one write; Cmd+Z takes it back
rows.observed: brush armed before the card true, on the card true; fx-agenda {"size":20} -> {"size":88,"weight":500,"align":"left"}; brush after the paint false, button aria-pressed null; after Cmd+Z {"size":20}

rows.name: paint-escape
rows.expected: back on the cover, the title selected and Paint format clicked, then Escape: the brush disarms and the button reads not pressed
rows.observed: armed: stage true, button aria-pressed null; after Escape: stage false, button aria-pressed null, is-on false

titleSelect.sel: selected true; resize handles 8; rotate true; ring true; chip "Title"; session false; caret false
